segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So it's usually in response to an invitation or suggestion.
segments.zh: 所以它通常是为了回应邀请或建议。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So let's take a look at our dialogue again and review everything and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 因此，让我们再次查看我们的对话并回顾所有内容，我们会稍后再回来。

segments.en: So Michelle, let me introduce you to Maria.
segments.zh: 所以米歇尔，让我把你介绍给玛丽亚。

segments.en: She's my colleague from Brazil.
segments.zh: 她是我来自巴西的同事。

segments.en: Maria, this is Michelle.
segments.zh: 玛丽亚，这位是米歇尔。

segments.en: Hi Michelle.
segments.zh: 你好，米歇尔。

segments.en: So what do you do here in Shanghai?
segments.zh: 那么你在上海做什么呢？

segments.en: I mean, what work do you do?
segments.zh: 我的意思是，你做什么工作？

segments.en: I work in advertising right now.
segments.zh: 我现在从事广告工作。

segments.en: How about you?
segments.zh: 你呢？

segments.en: I'm actually in the wine business.
segments.zh: 我实际上是从事葡萄酒行业。

segments.en: Oh, that sounds really great.
segments.zh: 哦，听起来真的很棒。

segments.en: I love wine myself.
segments.zh: 我自己也喜欢葡萄酒。

segments.en: Is this your first time to Shanghai, Maria?
segments.zh: 这是你第一次来上海吗，玛丽亚？

segments.en: No, actually, I often visit.
segments.zh: 不，实际上，我经常访问。

segments.en: I usually come to China for business at least once a year.
segments.zh: 我通常每年至少来中国出差一次。

segments.en: Also I love the restaurants in Shanghai.
segments.zh: 我也喜欢上海的餐馆。

segments.en: So that's a good reason to come.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个很好的理由来了。

segments.en: Me too.
segments.zh: 我也是。

segments.en: Actually, there's a great Brazilian restaurant I recommend.
segments.zh: 实际上，我推荐一家很棒的巴西餐厅。

segments.en: I mean, the food is delicious, but the service isn't so good.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，食物很美味，但服务不是很好。

segments.en: I often like to get together with friends and have a great barbecue there.
segments.zh: 我经常喜欢和朋友聚在一起，在那里烧烤。

segments.en: We should go there together sometime.
segments.zh: 我们应该有时间一起去那里。

segments.en: Wonderful idea.
segments.zh: 好主意。

segments.en: I'd love that.
segments.zh: 那我很乐意。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So as we can see, it's very quick, small conversation, but very good phrases to talk to a stranger, to start up a small conversation.
segments.zh: 正如我们所看到的，这是非常快速、小巧的对话，但与陌生人交谈的短语非常好，开始小对话。

segments.en: I think these are great too, Marco, because if you're learning English and you want to practice your speaking skills, you're not going to have many people to talk about deep things with.
segments.zh: 我认为这些也很棒，Marco，因为如果你正在学习英语并且你想练习你的口语技巧，你就不会有很多人可以谈论深刻的事情。

segments.en: So it's great to use with strangers or with people in your office.
segments.zh: 因此，非常适合与陌生人或办公室中的人一起使用。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And these are common, typical questions.
segments.zh: 这些是常见的典型问题。

segments.en: And they're also appropriate to ask someone.
segments.zh: 他们也适合问别人。

segments.en: So obviously, if you meet someone new, you're not going to ask them how much money they make because that's kind of inappropriate in Western culture.
segments.zh: 很明显，如果你遇到一个新人，你不会问他们赚了多少钱，因为这在西方文化中是不合适的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So what we've taught you here are very polite, very common phrases.
segments.zh: 所以我们在这里教给你的是非常有礼貌、非常常见的短语。

segments.en: We hope, hope, hope that you'll go out and practice these.
segments.zh: 我们希望，希望，希望你能出去练习这些。

segments.en: If you have questions or comments, don't hesitate to leave them for us.
segments.zh: 如果您有任何问题或意见，请不要犹豫，将它们留给我们。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
